subject: math
title: Count by 10s and 5s
about: Counting by tens to 100 and then by fives to 100, with boxes of ten and hands of five as the pictures. Counting by tens is a kindergarten skill that NC.1.NBT.2 builds on (ten ones make a ten); counting by fives is a stretch toward NC.2.NBT.2, so the fives cards come second.
tip: Clap on every count by tens; for fives, hold up one hand per count and say the numbers in a rhythm.
